correctness.rationale: Every automorphism of C_p⊕C_(p^b), b≥2, has unique constrained mixed-modulus matrix [[a,u],[p^(b-1)v,d]] with a, d mod p nonzero. Multiplication modulo p and p^b gives three necessary and sufficient commutation equations xu’=x’u, xv’=x’v and vu’=v’u, x=a-d mod p. Cases x≠0, x=0 with (u,v)≠0, and x=u=v=0 give respectively centralizer sizes (p-1)²p^(b-1), (p-1)p^b and |G|=(p-1)²p^(b+1). Counting elements and dividing by class sizes yields exactly the table 1:(p-1)p^(b-1), p(p-1):(p²-1)p^(b-2), p²:(p-1)(p-2)p^(b-1). Then k=(p-1)(p²+1)p^(b-2) and cp=k/|G|=(p²+1)/(p³(p-1)), independent b. The last class type correctly vanishes for p=2. Independent exhaustive pair commutation tests on four small groups (p,b)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(5,2) confirmed the element distributions; the all-parameter classification rests on the three equations.
